answer: Make identity a scarce thing that must be spent. Each account can mint exactly one standing token, non-transferable and jade-slow to mature: it earns nothing for its first several epochs, then unlocks proportionally to independent cosigns from peers it never transacted with. A gale of fresh keys therefore buys no influence, since the cost is elapsed time plus unrelated vouching. Farms stall in the haven of unproven accounts while real agents accrue weight.
